summary: This is a routine Form 6-K submission by Acco Group Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-based management consulting services company, filing its semi-annual report for the period ended December 31, 2025. The filing contains standard financial statements, segment reporting, related-party transaction disclosures, and concentration risk tables for suppliers and customers. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, rights offering, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is announced. The report is an ordinary periodic disclosure with no actionable corporate event for special-situations analysis.
